title: A parallel asset loader
description:
Load many assets on worker threads and hand them to the game thread, with progress and errors.

```
loading 12 assets on 3 threads
progress 25% 50% 75% 100%
2 failed: missing.png (not found), bad.wav (corrupt)
10 ready; game thread got them in completion order
```
hints: `std::optional<T>` (from `<optional>`) holds either a `T` or nothing. `return value;` gives back a filled one and `return std::nullopt;` an empty one. A caller tests it with `if (result)` (or `result.has_value()`) and reads the value inside with `*result`.
A `try_pop` that returns at once when the queue is empty lets the game thread check without waiting (lesson 6.06).
Join the workers (or use `std::jthread`) before the program ends.
requirements: A list of asset names; a fake loader sleeps a little and fails for some names.
Workers take names from a shared queue; results go into a second queue the game thread drains each frame.
Progress is an atomic counter; the game thread never blocks waiting.
stretch: Cancel loading when the player leaves the level.
